name: test-and-release
description: Verify implementation and prepare evidence-based handover.

# Test and Release Gate

1. Derive tests from approved acceptance criteria.
2. Follow RED-GREEN-REFACTOR for behavior changes.
3. Run focused tests and the repository's documented full suite.
4. Verify critical end-to-end journeys and negative/error paths.
5. Record environment, commands, results, and evidence.
6. Mark unrun checks as NOT VERIFIED; never infer a pass.
7. Audit known defects, deployment, rollback, monitoring, and handover notes.
